methodologyNotes: Roster covers nine real, independently verified models across battery-handheld, gas-handheld, corded, and gas-backpack form factors: EGO LB6504, Greenworks Pro 80V (BLB741), Ryobi 40V Whisper RY404100, Stihl BGA 57, Husqvarna 350BT, Worx Nitro WG581, DeWalt DCBL770 FlexVolt, Toro PowerJet F700, and Echo PB-2620. Headline specs re-verified against manufacturer product pages (egopowerplus.com, husqvarna.com, dewalt.com, ryobitools.com, echo-usa.com, toro.com, stihlusa.com) and corroborated by Pro Tool Reviews, leafblowerguide.com, and major retail listings (Home Depot, Costco, Best Buy, AutoZone). max_cfm and max_mph are manufacturer-stated peak values (MPH at concentrator/round nozzle where noted); weight_lb is bare-tool unless the model is only published with-battery (noted per product); noise_dba is operator-ear or tool-level per manufacturer/review data; backpack boolean (true=worn on back); battery_ah null for gas/corded. Husqvarna 350BT CFM is the at-pipe/nozzle figure (494) per the official Husqvarna US page, not the in-housing figure (692) cited by some retailers. Corrections this pass: DeWalt DCBL770B tool-only price reduced from $269 to $229 (no MSRP on official page; retailers cluster $229-$249). All accessedAt 2026-06-15.

products.name: EGO Power+ LB6504 650 CFM Cordless Blower
products.priceNote: Kit with 56V 5.0Ah battery and charger; ~$279.99 (lowest recorded, Lowe's), street ~$300
products.provenance: 650 CFM / 180 MPH / 56V / 5.0Ah / 64 dB confirmed on egopowerplus.com official product page. Bare-tool weight 4.77 lb (9.7 lb with battery) confirmed by leafblowerguide.com; lowest recorded price $279.99 (Lowe's), street ~$300 (Amazon/Walmart/Ace) per Consumer Reports/retail listings. Release year 2020.

products.name: Greenworks Pro 80V 800 CFM Brushless Leaf Blower (BLB741)
products.priceNote: Launch kit with 2.5Ah battery and charger; $249.99 at Costco per Pro Tool Reviews (Sept 2024). A later Costco bundle ships a 4Ah battery at a different price.
products.provenance: Model BLB741, 800 CFM / 200 MPH / 80V, bare-tool weight 6.75 lb, noise 85 dBA (high) / 90 dBA (turbo), included 2.5Ah battery, kit price $249.99 at Costco — all confirmed by Pro Tool Reviews (review dated Sept 20, 2024). Greenworks official 800CFM page returns 403 on direct fetch but is the canonical product reference; note a separately-listed Costco bundle now ships a 4Ah battery, so the 2.5Ah/$249.99 figures reflect the documented launch configuration.

products.name: Ryobi 40V HP Brushless 730 CFM Whisper Series Blower Kit (RY404100)
products.priceNote: Kit with two 4.0Ah batteries and charger; $329 per ryobitools.com
products.provenance: 730 CFM / 40V / two 4.0Ah batteries / 2-hour runtime / $329 confirmed on ryobitools.com official kit page. 190 MPH confirmed by Home Depot and Amazon listings; bare-tool weight 6.4 lb and noise 72 dB (high, 'Whisper Series 86% quieter than gas') per leafblowerguide.com/Pro Tool Reviews. Battery_ah reflects each of the two included batteries. Release year 2021.

products.name: Stihl BGA 57 Battery Handheld Blower
products.priceNote: Tool-only price ($219.99 regular at authorized dealers); kit with AK 20 battery and AL 101 charger sold at higher price
products.provenance: 365 CFM / 123 MPH / 36V confirmed via Stihl USA listing and corroborated by Ace Hardware/Northern Tool. Bare-tool weight 5.1 lb and 64 dB per leafblowerguide.com. battery_ah 4.0 = the AK 20 battery used with this tool. Tool-only price $219.99 regular at authorized Stihl dealers (Foreside Outdoor Power, Arco Lawn); Stihl MAP rules hide list price at some retailers. Release year 2021 per dealer model-year listings.

products.name: Husqvarna 350BT Gas Backpack Leaf Blower
products.priceNote: Suggested retail price; street pricing ranges ~$320 to ~$430 by retailer
products.provenance: Confirmed on husqvarna.com US page: max air flow at nozzle 494.41 CFM (rounded 494), max air speed 180.01 MPH, cylinder displacement 50.2 cm3, weight 22.5 lb, sound pressure at operator's ear 94 dB(A). Amazon title cites 692 CFM (in-housing) — the at-pipe 494 CFM is the official spec. MSRP $319.95 per common retailer SRP; release year not found in verified sources (null).

products.name: Worx Nitro 40V 530 CFM QuietTech Leaf Blower (WG581)
products.priceNote: Kit (WG581.1) with two 4.0Ah batteries and charger, $219.99 per Worx; tool-only (WG581.9) $119.99
products.provenance: 530 CFM / 180 MPH / 40V (2x20V) / 57 dB confirmed across Worx product page (search-cited) and leafblowerguide.com. Weight 7.7 lb with battery (4.2 lb bare) and two 4.0Ah batteries (WA3012) per leafblowerguide.com. Kit price $219.99 per Worx; tool-only WG581.9 $119.99 (Best Buy/Walmart). worx.com US page 301-redirects to EU domain on fetch; specs sourced from cached US listing + leafblowerguide.com + Best Buy/Target. Release year not found (null).

products.name: DeWalt FLEXVOLT 60V MAX Brushless Cordless Handheld Blower (DCBL770)
products.priceNote: Tool-only (DCBL770B) street price ~$229 (AutoZone/Power Tool Store; retailers $229-$249); no MSRP on official page. Kit DCBL770X1 with 9.0Ah battery sold separately at higher price.
products.provenance: 423 CFM, 129 MPH axial / 175 MPH with flat concentrator, 60V MAX (FlexVolt), 7 lb, 67 dBA — all confirmed on DeWalt official DCBL770B tool-only page. battery_ah 9.0 = the 9.0Ah FlexVolt battery included in the DCBL770X1 kit (confirmed on official kit page). Tool-only price corrected 269->229: official page lists no price; AutoZone $229.99, Power Tool Store $229.00, other retailers up to ~$249. Release year not found (null).

products.name: Toro PowerJet F700 Corded Electric Leaf Blower (51624)
products.provenance: 725 CFM / 140 MPH / 6.75 lb / $89.99 confirmed directly on toro.com official product page (corded, 12A). Noise 70.1 dB per leafblowerguide.com (rounded to 70). Release year not found in verified sources (null).

products.name: Echo PB-2620 X Series Handheld Gas Leaf Blower
products.priceNote: MSRP per echo-usa.com official product page
products.provenance: 172 MPH / 25.4cc / 9.8 lb dry / 70 dB(A) / $329.99 MSRP confirmed on echo-usa.com official product page; 456 CFM per Amazon/Home Depot/Walmart listings (official page omits CFM). Launch February 1, 2019 per Echo's own news announcement (echotools.com). Weight 9.8 lb dry (official) vs 9.7 lb sometimes cited.
